dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: requirements.txt includes urllib2 as it was detected in imports. Note that urllib2 is a Python 2 library; for Python 3.9, consider using urllib.request instead. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, sets up working directory, installs dependencies, copies code, and sets default command (update 'your_script.py' to actual entry point).
